remarks: Great opportunity to buy Spacious, Bright & well kept 3 bedrooms and 2 Full bath Raised Ranch in excellent condition in the convenient location of Bulls Head. 1st floor has a very spacious Living Room with Fireplace, 2 Good size bed rooms, full bath. Beautiful EAT-IN Kitchen with new appliances, Granite countertops and marble back splash with Sliders to Huge deck.  Bathroom was recently updated. Pull Down Attic is good for storage. Lower level is perfect for in-law suite with back door entry. Good for big family. Bedroom, Family room, full bath & laundry Room completes the lower level. Large fenced in yard. Circular driveway w/parking for 4+ cars. Circular parking for 4 cars, nice yard with above ground [pool AS IS. All this is within walking distance to E. Gaynor Brennan Golf & Scalzi Park. Minutes to everything--- shopping, library, hospital, I-95, Merritt Parkway & about 45minutes ride to NYC.
